description: The file contains C source code responsible for parsing /proc filesystem entries related to processes on Linux, specifically functions to extract parent process IDs and process names for process ancestry tracing.

methods.name: int parse_proc_stat(struct strbuf * sb,struct strbuf * name,int * statppid)
methods.description: Parses the content of /proc/[pid]/stat to extract the process name and parent process ID.

methods.name: int stat_parent_pid(pid_t pid,struct strbuf * name,int * statppid)
methods.description: Reads and parses the /proc/[pid]/stat file to obtain the parent process ID and process name.

methods.name: void push_ancestry_name(struct strvec * names,pid_t pid)
methods.description: Recursively collects the ancestry of a process by its parent process IDs and stores the process names.

methods.name: void trace2_collect_process_info(enum trace2_process_info_reason reason)
methods.description: Main function that collects process information based on reason, including process ancestry when starting up.

ctags.name: stat_parent_pid
ctags.pattern: /^static int stat_parent_pid(pid_t pid, struct strbuf *name, int *statppid)$/
